en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Harun al-Fami narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. Ja`far b. Jai` narrated to us from his father from Ibrahim b. Hashim from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Ibrahim b. Ziyad al-Karkhi. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:
On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will spread His mercy to the point where Iblis will hope for His mercy.
